meta.title: Isaac Wu | Developer Building with AI
meta.description: Isaac Wu — a developer who builds, researches and ships with AI: web apps, watch apps, and the self-hosted agents that run the chores behind them.

about.intro: Hello, I'm <1>Isaac Wu</1>, a developer who builds, researches and ships with AI — and a former project manager.
about.story: Sometimes I wondered—it would be perfect if I could know more about programming and software development when I was a project manager. That curiosity led me to dive deep into code.
about.ocean: When I'm not pushing pixels I'm usually underwater — freediving first, scuba whenever the sea allows. Same calm, same breath, different kind of depth.
about.now: Lately the daily chores go to a self-hosted Hermes Agent: it keeps my memory store backed up every day, runs the scheduled jobs, looks after the search service I host myself, and writes down what it learned from each mess it had to clean up. Less time on chores, more time on code — and building the small tools that fix my own problems is the part I enjoy most these days.
about.quote1: "These days it is not just web development --
about.quote2: I build with AI, research with it, and put the result to work
about.quote3: , turning ideas into tools people actually use."

showcases.subtitle: Selected Work
showcases.dodDesc: A website for recording diet by bringing your own data or importing from OpenFoodFacts API *This project is built by using serverless database, you might see errors when sending the first request. Please try again later.
showcases.intervalDesc: A watch-only interval timer for the Amazfit Balance 2. No phone app, no account: set work, rest, rounds and sets on the watch, hit start, and it counts down with vibration cues while you train.
showcases.apneaDesc: A dry static breath-hold trainer for the same watch. Runs CO₂ and O₂ tables -- the default CO₂ table is the one printed in the AIDA3 manual -- and walks you through every hold and rest interval on the dial.
showcases.sushiOtokoDesc: A per-plate bill calculator -- built for conveyor-belt sushi, but the custom mode takes any place that charges by the plate. The Sushiro, Kura and Sushi Express presets ship with their tier prices; in custom mode you name the tiers, set the prices and pick the colours yourself. Tap a tier each time a plate lands and the running total, service charge included once you switch it on, is there before you reach the register. Installs to the home screen and works offline.
